presetNotes:
Since arch glacor is a fairly random fight, with each fight giving completely attack rotations, I will not be giving a ability by ability guide. I will instead be giving general advice and what you want each attack to look like. This will be assuming you are using normal prayers.
Switch to spirit shield right before being hit by attacks for 30% and less damage. Try to keep enfeeble up on AG at all times, use pulverize while under berserk or for certain specials. Keep smoke cloud up whenever maging. Use prism of restoration fairly often to prevent kally from dying. Do not overspend bloodlust stacks, as we will need them for many specials. While normal prayers are rather risky to bring, especially at ag with the constant damage you take, I have found with mages sustain and likelyhood to crit, it is fairly safe and consistent.
Remember to prepot overload, summoning renewal, weapon poison+++, kwuarm, spirit weed, and lantadyme inceanse sticks, and powder of penance and protection. Remember to store a master magic cape for longer debuff duration.

Pre use dragon battle axe and get back to full adren at wars. Enter the arch glacor arena and place a dummy, use natural instinct, then get back to full adren, stall meteor strike and drink a adrenaline renewal potion, once able use berserk, spawn arch glacor and release meteor strike with greater barge. Ezk spec, switch to leng swords and stall flurry, then switch back to ezk and release flurry with overpower, now depending on crits you hopefully will have enough adren for enfeeble + pulverize, if not use some basic abilities to get enough adren. If you get either minions or arms, you will need to change this rotation.

If the first mechanic is minions, they will instantly spawn albeit without the bolstered, but still make invulnarable, requiring use of a different rotations. instead equip tumekens light and release meteor strike with adaptive strike in such a way all 4 minions are hit, then position yourself in such a way that all minions are within 1 tile of you, then use leng spec, finally equip ring of death and tumekens light then use its spec. Now that the minions are dead, stall adaptive for adren then wait for greater barge, once greater barge will bleed channelled release it with adaptive strike then use ezk spec, then rend, stall gflurry and release it with dismember, by now zerk will be close to running out, so switch to mage and be ready for the next special.

The east most rampart is L1 and west most is R1, as you move closer to the middle, it will be a bigger number so 1 rampart west of middle/5 is R4. If you see the indicator coming from the east and stopping at 5 it is cannon, if it instead stops at R4 it is beams. If it is going from the west it is always cannon. If the indicator comes from both sides and stops right before rampart 4 also known as 3.9 then it is arms, if the indicator goes just past 4 aka 4.1 it is cannon. For flurry we don't have to look at the ice as the game gives us a nice message about AG focusing attacks, and this appears before the indicators would tell us anything, making flurry the easiest to 'predict.' On the opposite side of the spectrum minions does not have ice, making it the hardest to pridect, however since we know roughly when AG should do a special, you can recognize minions by the lack of ice. If you don't see any indicators at the very end of beams it is minions, if you don't see ice after flurry it is minions.
For cannon activate eclipsed soul or disable protection prayer, equip spirit shield (be careful of getting smited) use vengeance, vit burst, reprisal, reflect, freedom, and for the final hit use resonance. With this method you will heal most of the damage you receive, while also recoiling up to 60k damage. If you time the vit burst to run out in between the 2nd and 3rd hit, you will heal all damage received. If wanting to be safer or if you get a back to back cannon instead use anticipate, debilitate or reflect or even shield dome if it is at 50% block, then use protect mage for the first 2 hits, for the third use resonance, if resonance is on cooldown use preparation for the first 2 hits which should bring resonance of cooldown, if it's still on cooldown the last resort is devotion. For flury it is recommended use pulverize so we don't take to much damage, make sure enfeeble is active. Try to use either debilitate or reflect, shield dome may also be used, even if it is at 25%. With spirit shield flicks this is not strictly necessary. If hp is a major problem disruption shield can help tank some damage. If you feel you have enough time before cannons and it's off cooldown you can use a resonance or if hp is fine divert, after doing either be sure to use preparation to make sure it is ready for cannon. For minions use debiliate on bolstered glacyte, or shield dome which will block all damage not just the bolstered but will scale its defense down, minions can be done with 25% dome but 50% is much safer. You want to do this since we will be both taking more damage and be unable to easily spirit shield flick. If it is off cooldown and think it will be off cooldown before cannon or you feel safer debilitating cannon, you can elect to use a reflect.
For mage minions use greater chain with roar of awakening equiped, use either soulflame or omni power whatever is off cooldown, aim them at the bolstered as the target will take slightly more damage then the chained. Switch back to FSoA, then use magma tempest at the center of the group, then concentrated blast, next use a runic charge dragons breath, now use blood barrage for healing and adren regain, then greater chain, switch to ring of death and use penence trident spec EoF, this time aim at the glacyte with the most hp. If you don't think the trident spec will kill use a different AoE attack, we want to kill with trident for the insane adren regain.
For melee minions you should already have built some bloodlust stacks knowing it could be minions, equip tumekens light use its spec then use adaptive to get adren back and a bloodlust stack then hurricane, as long as it hits all minions plus ag and you had 4 bloodlust it should completely reset the cooldown therefore allowing us to use a second cane. After this use adaptive strike, greater fury, then rend to get back up to 4 stacks, in this time cane will come off cooldown allowing us to use another double hurricane. For arms I don't have an exact rotation. It will look fairly similar to minions, just less AoE. You can also just improvise with strong damaging attacks, I would say as far as dps attacks go, arms is on the highest priority, meaning no attack is to precious for arms. If maging make sure you have sunshine active and FSoA spec, and have 100% adren before it starts. For melee make sure you have a fair few bloodlust stacks and more importantly having berserk active is absolutely critical. If your buffs are close to running out and you think arms might be next, do a early switch, activate your buffs, and if you see it is arms and are not at max adren use a adren pot and be ready to use devotion. You should not use ezk as we will not have flame bound rival on the arms, making leng swords better. Surprisingly we rarely need devotion, with powder of protection and spirit shield flicks we are taking fairly low damage from auto attacks and flurry, and we will usually be clearing arms before it is needed, however it is recommended to still save it, using it only when life or death, it is better to try to recoil damage and deal it back then it is to not take the damage. Berserk is a rather risky skill to use for AG, it cannot be used for cannon if you intend on doing a recoil rotation, or else you take way to much damage, if you are instead simply stacking defencives then it is fine. For arms and minions if you don't get a proper fast clear then you will take a lot of damage, and you will probably get a slow clear if you are trying to use berserk reactionary, as you will have very little adren to start, so it is really only safe if you have can use it while still getting your adren back before the attack. It is very safe to use during beams but you won't be able to take full effect of it with beams do to you being out of attack range during it. For flurry you can use it relatively safely thanks to things like powder of protection and flamebound rival make you take a minumal amount of damage.

The average arch glacor kill in this setup is between 6-7 mins, so you may think we must manually bring a overload, but with the lantadyme incense sticks, our overload timer will be extended to 8 minutes allowing us to safely skip the overload potion.
We don't bring a nexus, as we will not be using darkness, and even if we where we could pre use it, and we don't need bone shield as we can simply switch to a shield to activate any defensives
Since we are hybriding, a HM zuk cape is needed (it's not that hard you can do it)
